result:
I loaded proj:demo and then dropped it. I didn't run the librarian's commit step, because loading and dropping file no records, so I printed no `DESK:` lines.

**Load**
- proj:demo is mounted on the bus at `spaces/proj-demo` with `rw` access.
- This node hadn't cloned the space yet, so I set it up from the bus and then pulled its latest commit. That moved it from `3a4c5e7` to `90b5a1c` and added `notes/README.md`.
- The space holds two records:
  - `note-20261001T1100Z-a0b1`: "Why the demo greeting lives in alpha"
  - `README`: no title
- It was read-only for this session; anything to file in it goes to the space's librarian.

**Drop**
- I took proj:demo out of this session's loaded set, which is now empty. The clone stays on disk and nothing was deleted.

**Bus state:** I staged, committed and pushed nothing on the bus. But `git status` on the bus now shows `M spaces/proj-demo`. That's because the bus still records the space's older commit, while the clone is now on its latest one. This mismatch is normally hidden by an `ignore = all` setting for the space, and the bus's `.gitmodules` doesn't have that setting, so it shows. It's only in the local checkout, and it shouldn't be committed. If you want it hidden, the operator can add the setting with:
`git -C <scratch>/runs/20261028T082926Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-c7e0/repos/bus config -f .gitmodules submodule.spaces/proj-demo.ignore all`

cat ~/.agent-identity.env 2>/dev/null | grep REPO_PATH; B=<scratch>/runs/20261028T082926Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-c7e0/repos/bus; P=proj:demo
entry=$(grep -E "id:[[:space:]]*$P[[:space:]]*[,}]" "$B/spaces.yaml" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
path=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | sed -n 's/.*path:[[:space:]]*\([^,}[:space:]]*\).*/\1/p')
access=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | sed -n 's/.*access:[[:space:]]*\([a-z]*\).*/\1/p')
if [ -n "$path" ] && git config -f "$B/.gitmodules" --get-regexp '^submodule\..*\.path$' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | grep -qxF "$path"; then echo "MOUNTED $P $path ${access:-?}"; else echo "NOT MOUNTED $P"; fi; ls -la $B; cat $B/spaces.yaml

input.command:
S=<scratch>/runs/20261028T082926Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-c7e0/repos/bus/spaces/proj-demo
c=$(git -C <scratch>/runs/20261028T082926Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-c7e0/repos/bus/spaces/proj-demo rev-parse --short HEAD)
echo "proj:demo  spaces/proj-demo  access rw  $c"

for d in notes decisions; do for f in "$S/$d"/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue
id=$(sed -n 's/^id:[[:space:]]*//p' "$f" | head -1)
title=$(sed -n 's/^title:[[:space:]]*//p' "$f" | head -1 | sed 's/^"\(.*\)"$/\1/')
printf '%s  %s\n' "${id:-$(basename "$f" .md)}" "$title"; done; done
DIR="${CLAUDE_CODE_CONFIG_DIR:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}}/mesh-load"
mkdir -p "$DIR"; F="$DIR/${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID}.loaded"; touch "$F"
grep -qxF 'proj:demo' "$F" || printf '%s\n' 'proj:demo' >> "$F"
echo "loaded: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$F")"
